title: content/exercise-images.json
description: Own SVG start/end figures per exercise (issue #653). tools/validate/exercise-images.mjs enforces this and the cross-file rules (every key is an exercise in exercises.json, unique files and source ids, no colours baked into the SVG).

images.description: Keyed by exercise name as in exercises.json.

file.description: Unique logical file name; the SVG text is inline in svg so the bundle is self-contained.

svg.description: At most 8192 BYTES (the validator counts UTF-8 bytes; maxLength counts characters and is only a necessary bound). Strict allowlist enforced by tools/validate/svg-allowlist.mjs: elements svg g line circle ellipse rect path title, fixed attributes per element, double-quoted values, no url(, no comments. viewBox is 0 0 w h on the root. Colours only none, currentColor or var(--fig-body|arm|hl|eq|bg).

frames.description: Start frame, then end frame. One frame for moves without a useful end pose.

source.description: Own drawings only until an ADR allows a third-party source.
